newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kajiyama says hopes better rates will be available.
newsitem.headline: Kajiyama says hopes better rates will be available.

text.p: Chief Cabinet Secretary Seiroku Kajiyama told a parliamentary committee on Friday he hoped financial products with slightly higher interest rates would become available for the sake of those dependent on interest income.

"The Ministry of Finance (MOF) has been saying that interest rates won't rise, but maybe financial products with better interest may become available," said Kajiyama, who is the chief government spokesman.
He also expressed doubt as to whether capital outflows resulting from a revision of Japan's Foreign Exchange Control Law would be so easily prevented as MOF insisted would be the case.
He said it would benefit Japan if financial assets held by private individuals were managed effectively.
